correctness_confidence.basis: The core algebraic proofs (Theorems 1-4), Hopfield dynamical-matrix formulation, Vieta invariants, and numerical values in C01-C16 verify cleanly. Minor issues: (i) prose in the Abstract and Sec. 4.2 states eta_leak(MP0) <= 16/49 from delta_gap <= 1.05 THz (valid only at the best-case midpoint delta_gap = 1.05 THz, whereas C01 has delta_gap = 0.8206 THz, giving 53.5%), (ii) C15 reports eta_leak = 1.306 > 1 without flagging perturbative breakdown, and (iii) the simplified g_D^2 = g^2/2 deuteration scaling.

rigor.basis: Clear, self-contained mathematical derivations (notably the elementary AM-GM proof of two-band ZPE positivity and the root-free MP0 brightness bound) paired with an explicit three-layer epistemic boundary separating machine-checked claims from physical caveats. Limited by reliance on a single-mode lossless Hamiltonian without cavity/dephasing linewidths and the inability to audit external Lean/Python files from the PDF alone.

novelty.basis: Applies standard gauge-invariant Hopfield theory, 1/N Kerr suppression, and inhomogeneous dark-manifold perturbation bounds to the realistic CH2 symmetric/antisymmetric lipid doublet, contributing a neat calculus-free proof of universal two-band ZPE positivity, a root-free MP0 suppression ceiling, and a concrete CH2->CD2 deuteration and 2D-IR falsification matrix.

significance.basis: Establishes sharp, experimentally testable discriminators (six-order-of-magnitude 2D-IR anharmonicity contrast, gel-phase MP0 visibility window, and >10 THz D2O-clear deuteration shifts) that directly adjudicate the unrefereed 71 THz mito-polariton hypothesis.

reproducibility.basis: All Hamiltonian definitions, parameters, secular equations, and benchmark numbers (C01-C16) are explicitly stated and reproducible by hand from the PDF; external Lean 4.36.0 and exact-Q Python artifacts are referenced by SHA-256 manifest but cannot be directly inspected within this single-PDF review.

summary: This manuscript extends the gauge-invariant cubic Hopfield model to the two-band aliphatic CH2 stretching doublet (85.4 and 87.5 THz) of phospholipid bilayers and derives quantitative spectroscopic falsification criteria for the proposed 71 THz mitochondrial crista polariton. Four main theorems establish TRK diamagnetic cancellation and strict root interlacing trapping a middle polariton (MP0) inside (85.4, 87.5) THz, universal positive zero-point energy shift via an elementary AM-GM argument, a root-free universal ceiling showing >100x USC suppression of MP0 photonic weight (0.33% in C01 vs. 35.5% in C05), and exact 1/N suppression of collective Kerr anharmonicity in 2D-IR. Combined with a Schur-complement dark-manifold leakage bound contrasting LP protection against MP0 disorder mixing and a CH2->CD2 deuteration shift to (58.36, 64.24) THz clear of the 75 THz D2O band, the work provides a mathematically sound and epistemically transparent experimental testbed, requiring only minor revisions to tighten inequality wording on the MP0 leakage bound and clarify modeling idealizations.
strengths: Exact TRK cancellation, positive-definiteness by completing the square, and strict Cauchy-Hopfield root interlacing (Theorem 1) are cleanly proved and numerically consistent across all tabulated regimes (C01-C09).
Theorem 2 gives an unusually clean, completely elementary calculus-free algebraic proof of universal two-band ZPE positivity using Vieta relations and the three-variable AM-GM inequality.
Theorem 3 derives an exact, root-free universal upper bound on MP0 photonic weight explaining why linear mid-IR measurements can miss MP0 in USC (0.332% in C01 vs. 35.48% at crossover C05).

Prescribes a concrete, multi-pronged experimental falsification protocol (2D-IR 1/N anharmonicity and polariton-dark cross-peak, gel-phase MP0 search, and CH2->CD2 deuteration avoiding the 75 THz D2O O-D stretch).

Explicitly separates formally verified mathematical claims from physical modeling caveats (Fermi resonances, CH3 stretches) and unverified experimental premises of Ref. [1], while disclosing operator conflict.
weaknesses: The physical model omits cavity decay (kappa), homogeneous vibrational dephasing (gamma), and multimode in-plane wavevector dispersion of crista cavities, treating only a single lossless cavity mode with static diagonal disorder.

The PDF alone does not include the full source of the cited Lean 4.36.0 proofs or exact-Q Python verifier/manifest, so machine-verification claims cannot be independently executed from this file alone.
Figure 2(a) cites '(Thm. 11)' (the Lean theorem index) rather than Theorem 3 in the manuscript text, which is mildly confusing to a reader.
potential_errors: In the Abstract and Sec. 4.2 (p. 7), the text notes delta_gap <= 1.05 THz for MP0 and immediately writes eta_leak(MP0) <= 16/49 (~32.65%) at sigma_inh = 0.6 THz (and <= 1/49 at sigma_inh = 0.15 THz). However, delta_gap <= 1.05 THz implies sigma_inh^2 / delta_gap^2 >= 16/49, so 16/49 is the best-case midpoint bound (Table 1 C14/C16 at delta_gap = 1.05 THz), whereas off-midpoint MP0 states yield a larger bound (e.g., C01 at 86.2206 THz has delta_gap = 0.8206 THz and bound 53.5%).

In Section 4.2 (C15, sigma_inh = 1.2 THz), the second-order perturbative expression yields eta_leak = 1.306, which exceeds unity and therefore marks breakdown of second-order perturbation theory rather than a literal leakage probability.

In Section 3 (p. 5), the CH2->CD2 deuteration protocol scales squared couplings as g_j^(D)2 approx g_j^2 / 2 'by reduced mass', whereas in Coulomb-gauge Hopfield theory TRK scaling (D ~ 1/m_red) gives g_j^2 ~ omega_j / m_red ~ m_red^(-3/2) (~0.40 g_j^2) and fixed-envelope electric-dipole scaling gives g_j^2 ~ (m_red * omega_j)^(-1) ~ m_red^(-1/2) (~0.73 g_j^2); this O(1) difference does not affect the >9-10 THz clearance from the 75 THz D2O band.

Certificate C12 (N = 1 local mode, Delta_-- = 0.721 THz) evaluates Eq. (15) at N1 = N2 = 1 using C01's collective USC weights (w1,-, w2,-), which is a useful mathematical contrast but physically idealized since a single oscillator cannot sustain collective USC couplings without an unphysical dipole; an uncoupled local CH2 mode simply retains bare Delta ~ 3.6-4.2 THz.
strong_novelty_candidates: Elementary calculus-free AM-GM proof of universal two-band Hopfield zero-point energy positivity (Theorem 2).
Root-free universal analytical ceiling on MP0 photonic weight in two-band USC Hopfield systems (Theorem 3).
Acyl-chain CH2 -> CD2 lipid deuteration protocol shifting both LP and MP0 more than 10 THz below the 75 THz D2O O-D solvent interference band.
